notes: Historical income statement items (operating revenues, operating income, D&A) and capex were taken from the company’s FY2025 Form 10-K (values presented in the filing in millions, converted here to full USD). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))

EBIT is proxied as Operating income from the consolidated statement of operations (company uses 'operating income' rather than an explicit EBIT label). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))

NWC construction (historical and forecast driver) uses: NWC = (Total current assets - Cash and cash equivalents) - (Total current liabilities - Short-term debt - Current portion of long-term debt). This definition excludes cash and debt from working capital and can produce swings due to customer timing (e.g., unbilled revenues and payables). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))
Tax rate set to the company’s 2025 effective tax rate of 21.9% for base-case. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))

NOL balance is modeled using disclosed state NOL carryforwards of $246m at Dec 31, 2025; NOL utilization is set to the provided 0.80 parameter. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))

WACC is set using an external market-data proxy (StockAnalysis) of 6.38%; this is an estimate rather than a filed-company parameter. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/awk/statistics/?utm_source=openai))
Current price uses the latest available quote as of Mar 20, 2026 close (used for Mar 21, 2026 as-of presentation).

Investments field is left null because the schema’s 'investments' meaning is not explicitly standardized versus capex/depreciation in the provided pipeline requirements; capex and D&A already capture reinvestment intensity. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))

The company indicates a pending transaction with Essential Utilities (referenced in GAAP-to-adjusted EPS discussion); base-case does not explicitly model merger-specific financial effects. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))

catalysts: Ongoing execution and outcomes of multi-state general rate cases (including incremental authorizations effective in 2026). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))

Capital program execution translating into rate base additions and subsequent depreciation/earnings run-rate. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))

Regulatory approval and integration progress related to the pending Essential Utilities transaction (not modeled explicitly in forecast drivers). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))
company_overview: Provides regulated water and wastewater services across multiple U.S. states, with revenue driven by authorized rate cases and infrastructure investments. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))

Generates operating income margin through a regulated cost-of-service framework and ongoing capital placement into the rate base. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))

Operates with a capital-intensive balance sheet and meaningful depreciation and amortization as a function of prior-year capex. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))
current_context: FY2025 operating revenues were $5.14bn and operating income was $1.88bn; D&A was $0.894bn and total capex was $3.126bn. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))

Incremental general rate case authorizations effective on/after Jan 1, 2026 were $14m (presented as annualized incremental revenues in the filing). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))

2025 effective tax rate was 21.9%, and state NOL carryforwards were $246m (with utilization modeled via the provided utilization rate). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth assumes continued rate-case-driven and infrastructure-supported demand, with moderation from the most recent years’ higher growth. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))

EBIT margin is held near the recent historical range (operating income divided by operating revenues), consistent with regulated cost recovery and scale. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))

D&A ramps with capex intensity (D&A as a percent of sales modeled slightly higher over the forecast horizon). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))

NWC is modeled to normalize (mean reversion) given large historical swings driven by working-capital timing effects. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))

Terminal value uses a Gordon growth framework with conservative long-run growth and a utility-appropriate WACC. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/awk/statistics/?utm_source=openai))
key_risks: Rate-case timing and regulatory outcomes could delay revenue recognition or reset allowed returns, pressuring EBIT margin. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))

Inflation and procurement pressures can cause O&M and financing costs to rise faster than allowed rates. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))

Balance-sheet and working-capital timing could deviate from the modeled NWC normalization, impacting cash flows available to equity. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))

valuation_summary: DCF base-case uses FY2025 revenue and operating income levels from the company’s latest Form 10-K, with forecast drivers aligned to historical margins, depreciation intensity, and capex intensity. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001410636/000141063626000034/awk-20251231.htm))

WACC is set to 6.38% as an external market-data proxy (StockAnalysis) and applied consistently across scenarios. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/awk/statistics/?utm_source=openai))

Peer comps use EV/Sales and EV/EBITDA alongside forward P/E; EV/EBITDA and EV/Sales are treated as latest available proxies, with forward P/E used as the NTM proxy. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/wtrg/statistics/))
